posts.title: Switched to EUPL v1.2 License and Improved Smolweb Compliance
posts.description: The project has switched from GPL v3.0 to EUPL v1.2 (European Union Public Licence). CSS has been updated to Grade A smolweb compliance by removing Grade B/C properties. All external links no longer use target="_blank".

posts.title: A Proper Docker Image for WebCalendar: SQLite-Backed, Multi-Arch, Nothing Hanging Outside the Container
posts.description: A self-contained, SQLite-backed, multi-arch Docker image for WebCalendar, built from git to sidestep an upstream packaging bug.

posts.title: Website improvements: accessibility, SEO, and 404 page
posts.description: Added skip-to-content navigation, Open Graph tags, favicon, sitemap, and a custom 404 page.
